falmouth.s1_head: Falmouth's marine, creative and professional core
s1loc: Falmouth's economy turns on its deep-water harbour, where A and P Falmouth runs one of the UK's largest ship-repair complexes with three graving docks and the Falmouth Docks and Enterprise Zone. Around it sit Cornwall Marine Network firms, marine engineers and the professional services that support them: accountancies, solicitors and consultancies handling contracts, payroll and finance for the port and the wider harbour estate. Falmouth University adds a fast-growing creative and design economy across the town.

Falmouth University and Falmouth Marine School feed a steady supply of design, technology and engineering graduates into local firms, and the two have partnered on a ship-repair management diploma for A and P project managers. The professional workforce here keeps suits for client meetings but steps into branded polos, softshells and fleeces for away days, conferences, exhibitions and sponsored fundraising events. Procurement and office managers order through us because the kit matches their brand exactly, every time.

Falmouth's economy combines one of the deepest natural harbours in the world with a strong engineering and creative base, anchored by the A and P Falmouth ship-repair docks, the marine cluster around the harbour, and Falmouth University's design, games and digital courses. Town-centre accountancies, law firms and surveying practices serve that base, giving procurement and office managers a steady reason to keep client-facing teams in consistent, on-brand kit.
